record.title: Classify the captured local boot report and prepare postboot observation
record.intent: Preserve the interrupted transition and recover only its missing observation boundary.
requirements: Preserve the stopped derived transition, exact introduction and rename lineage, attempted single normal reboot, server wait, positive helper retirement and immutable full capture with drop statistics. Establish the actual offending frame and captured post-reboot DHCP pair independently; do not call the stopped lifecycle complete.

Permit only the witnessed peer-origin link-local IPv6 multicast-listener report with its exact Hop-by-Hop Router Alert structure, bounded declared lengths, local multicast destination and validated terminal ICMPv6 message. Preserve existing IPv4, foreign-origin, nonlocal destination and other unexpected-protocol rejection. Test the actual frame and meaningful malformed or broadened negative controls.

Prepare a separate postboot-only observation controller with no native transaction or reboot route, anchored to the stopped introduction, previous stock software and protected baseline, actual reboot lease and finite deadline. Require one bounded UID-first connection, at most the existing conditional root request, changed boot, exact derived mapping and bytes, stock APK, protected corpus, status, ordinary UI, serviced settling and 1801-second warm-up, fixed16-byte 18/18 observation and final snapshot. Preserve bounded ownership and graceful closure.

Keep the original interrupted transition separate. The new observation has its own bounded 3000-second cap, because its question is the present postboot state; it cannot retry deployment or reset the specimen. Admit no RF records until its actual evidence is independently accepted. Preserve enough remaining time for the unchanged survey and final stock restoration before the existing finite deadline.
acceptance: A concrete strictly bounded observation fixture and actual stopped evidence are reviewable.
